title: Three Grove cranes and expanded customer support offering headline Manitowoc's JDL EXPO 2026 presence
summary: Manitowoc will bring three Grove cranes to JDL EXPO this September: the GMK5150XL, GMK4100L-2 and the GMK3060L-1.Alongside these models, Grove will also highlight the latest advances in its growing customer support operation.Potain will present its latest customer support products and will highlight its experience in constructing nuclear plants.
body_markdown:
- Manitowoc will bring three Grove cranes to JDL EXPO this September: the GMK5150XL, GMK4100L-2 and the GMK3060L-1.
- Alongside these models, Grove will also highlight the latest advances in its growing customer support operation.
- Potain will present its latest customer support products and will highlight its experience in constructing nuclear plants.


Manitowoc returns to France's premier lifting event,[JDL EXPO](https://jdlexpo.com/) , this September with three Grove all-terrain cranes and an expanded showcase of customer support solutions designed to maximize equipment performance and uptime. JDL EXPO is now one of Europe’s leading events for the industry, and 2026 will mark the 20th anniversary of the exhibition.


Manitowoc will demonstrate the versatility of its Grove all-terrain cranes, showing the[GMK5150XL](https://www.manitowoc.com/grove/all-terrain-cranes/gmk5150xl) ,[GMK4100L-2](https://www.manitowoc.com/grove/all-terrain-cranes/gmk4100l-2) , and[GMK3060L-1](https://www.manitowoc.com/grove/all-terrain-cranes/gmk3060l-1) . The GMK5150XL and GMK4100L-2 will be displayed in the colors of the[FOSELEV Group](https://www.foselev.com/en/) while the GMK3060L-1 belongs to[Groupe Cayon](https://www.transport-cayon.fr/) . Manitowoc will also spotlight its growing portfolio of customer support products and services to help owners maximize uptime, extend equipment life, and increase return on invested capital throughout the entire machine lifecycle.


“We’re proud to be part of JDL EXPO in its 20th year, and are ready to welcome customers, partners, and visitors to our stand,” said Olivier Regis, Manitowoc’s sales director of Grove mobile cranes in France. “We’ve got a great selection of cranes on show, but just as importantly we will be highlighting the support we provide through products, services, tools, and expertise to help customers get the most from their equipment. We have invested substantially in new service locations and personnel in France to help our customers achieve the maximum return from their Manitowoc products.”


## Three class-leading cranes


The GMK5150XL is a class leader, with a 68.7 m main boom – the longest for a 150 t mobile crane on a five-axle chassis. Its extended reach enables owners to complete many lifts at height without needing to configure a jib, reducing rigging time and required space on the jobsite.


Another long boom model is the GMK4100L-2, a 100 t four-axle all-terrain crane offering compact dimensions, strong lifting performance, and long reach. The crane can reach almost 89 m when working with jib extensions while its narrow width of 2.55 m allows it to easily access tight working areas.


Completing the JDL EXPO line-up is Grove’s three-axle, 60 t capacity GMK3060L-1 which features a compact 8.67 m carrier plus a 48 m seven-section MEGAFORM® boom that combines excellent reach with exceptional load charts. The crane can be operated outdoors as well as indoors, thanks to load charts that start at a 0° boom angle.
